interpretation: All 241 are downstream effects of the density-only first prototype. This does not establish 241 feature algorithm bugs. One of these rows is directly tied to a confirmed legacy surface integration defect. The separately confirmed jagged-peaks carving integration defect is absent from the A3 footprint and is not counted among these 241. Remaining surface rows mix geometric exposure with the legacy cutoff; per-row causal fractions require a controlled ablation and remain unverified. No independent tree/plant/ocean placement algorithm bug was demonstrated in this round.

confirmed_integration_defects.defect: Caves are carved after terrain without a density-aware upper-body surface guard
confirmed_integration_defects.evidence: Jagged-peaks raw terrain Y144 air 0/29496 before carving; native final air 4963/29496. Exact raw geometry denominator matches the native profile.

confirmed_integration_defects.defect: Ordinary surface rules remove grass/dirt solely above Y112, including fuzzy ordinary-biome neighbours of cherry grove
